plumbing.summary: Everything passed: gofmt, go vet, the tests of every package the change touches, and every acceptance test.
plumbing.review:
1. **Installed dependencies can replace the application being checked.** [language.go:565](repo/internal/verify/language.go#L565) puts libraries before `/src`; [line 574](repo/internal/verify/language.go#L574) also appends the driver’s directory last. If a wheel exports the same package name as the checkout, application imports resolve to the installed copy. Checks can therefore pass against the wrong implementation. Keep trusted paths first, then application paths, then dependencies, and add a collision regression.

2. **Dependency checks lose deterministic hashing.** The `-I` launchers at [language.go:568](repo/internal/verify/language.go#L568) and [line 573](repo/internal/verify/language.go#L573) ignore the `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` supplied at [line 616](repo/internal/verify/language.go#L616). Drivers choosing operations from sets can produce different traces despite identical random seeds. Preserve startup isolation while restoring deterministic hashing, and test repeated executions.

3. **Required merge evidence is outstanding.** [tests.txt:1](tests.txt#L1) reports success but supplies no final-head real-Docker/PyPI result. The parser comparison and hostile-wheel execution are conditional at [python_parser_accept_test.go:203](repo/internal/verify/python_parser_accept_test.go#L203) and [python_libraries_accept_test.go:86](repo/internal/verify/python_libraries_accept_test.go#L86). [README.md:140](repo/README.md#L140) requires that run; [line 146](repo/README.md#L146) also requires recording and citing the dependency-policy decision.

Otherwise, the changes stay within the allowed files, the acceptance sources match the plan, and I found no fixture-specific production bypass or additional host, network, secret-handling, or style issue. I did not run the test suite in this read-only review.

VERDICT: changes needed — fix import precedence and deterministic hashing with regression coverage, provide passing final-head Docker/PyPI output, and record and cite the dependency-policy decision.
